  ● [ idle ]                  ◀── YOU ARE HERE (2 steps to end)
      │
      │  checkout             if: loan_until is checkout + 14d
      ▼
  ○ [ on_loan ]               ↺ can also: recall
      │
      │  checkin              if: overdue is 0, or recall_placed is 1
      ▼
  ✔ [ returned ]  END
